args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted.
Flagged (2), both for summary_outlier:
- r03: Its largest flank difference is -7.97 %/h at 432 µm. The batch median is 0.495 %/h (z -103.8), so r03's value is about 16 times the batch value with the opposite sign.
- r04: Its flank difference has the opposite sign and peaks near the tip: -0.81 %/h at 84 µm, against about +0.5 %/h at 347 µm for the batch. Its growth zone is also shorter, 674 µm against 695 µm.
Cleared (6): r01, r02, r05, r06, r07, r08.
- All their final checks pass. Plane sections was not run for r02 because it was reported with the width-free ratio.
- Their REGR peaks (centre strain-rate peaks) match the batch at about 53.2 %/h at 421 µm, and their growth zones match at 695 µm.
- In r06 and r07 the flank difference peaks at an unusual position (21 µm). The difference itself is small and plane sections passes, so these runs were cleared.
What the flagged runs share: both were reported with the width-free ratio, so plane sections was not run. Both have a flank-difference profile (curvature-rate signal) of a different shape from the batch, and no final check confirms it. Their centre REGR peaks and peak positions are normal. r02 also used the width-free ratio but was cleared because its profile matches the batch.
